# netbox_device_bay_templates (Data Source)

Retrieves all device bay templates from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_bay_templates" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "device_bay_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_device_bay_templates.example.device_bay_templates[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `device_bay_templates` (Attributes List) The device bay templates found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_bay_templates))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--device_bay_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device_bay_templates`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) When the device bay templates was created.

- `device_type_id` (Number) The ID of the device type associated with the device bay templates.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the device bay templates.
- `id` (Number) The id of the device bay templates.
- `label` (String) The label of the device bay templates.
- `last_updated` (String) When the device bay templates was last changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the device bay templates.
